_doc: Source of truth for the Absinthe Arcade 3D exterior kit. Human-readable companion: design/worlds/debaucheryville/absinthearcade_3d_asset_manifest.md. Coordinates are engine space: meters, Y-up, facade front plane at z=0 facing +Z, building centered on x=0, sidewalk top at y=0 (same as blockout/arcade_building_base.gltf). dims = [width_x, height_y, depth_z].

building.tri_budget_policy: Unlimited (author ruling 2026-10-26): no polygon caps on any asset or on the building. tri_budget fields stay null; set a number on an asset only to opt it back into a cap.

pivots.facade: Building origin: x=0, y=0, z=0 on the facade front plane.
pivots.ground: Bottom center of the asset's footprint, resting on y=0.
pivots.wall: Center of the asset's back face, which sits flush on the wall plane.
pivots.sill: Bottom center of the window opening, on the facade front plane.

channels.B: Flicker phase offset 0..1 (per letter / per tube segment)
channels.A: Flicker enable: 0 = steady when lit, 1 = participates in blink/stutter

neon_mask.formula: emission = emissive_map * night + (R * green * anim(B, A) + G * purple * anim(B, A)) * night

texture_sets.target: Unity URP Lit (custom Shader Graph for neon assets)
texture_sets.mask: R = metallic, G = ambient occlusion, B = unused (0), A = smoothness. Assign the same texture to URP Lit's Metallic Map and Occlusion Map slots (URP reads metallic from R, smoothness from A, occlusion from G).

assets.contents: Limestone walls with the entrance arch cut through, entrance recess with a dark interior backing, side and back walls, gables, slate roof, swept plinth / ground-floor cornice / floor bands / dentilled eave cornice, rusticated corner quoins. Tileable limestone from a Tripo-generated swatch (textures/m_aa_limestone_tile_*).

Molded stone archivolt + jamb plinths (Blender), Headphone Gentleman sculpt + rebuilt junction-box earcups and conduit (Tripo + Blender), stepped pixel ABSINTHE ARCADE marquee (Tripo), crisp tagline text panel over the marquee bar (generated texture), two stained-glass door leaves flanking the walkway (Tripo, mirrored), green neon loop over the head on standoff clips (Blender).

Baroque window unit: carved limestone surround (its small Tripo cartouche is cut off; aa_ornament_window_crest sits on the hood instead), projecting sill, dark wood casement with transom, sheer curtains, terracotta geranium box. Replaces the separate trim + glass plan. No animals (reference cat removed). RETIRED 2026-10-27 (architectural pass): upper windows are now procedural openings, surrounds and casements in aa_shell_facade (build_shell.py); the Tripo prefab sat in front of the wall and was skewed ~10 degrees.

Round-headed window in carved limestone arch, fanlight tracery, sheer curtains, plus its projecting stone balcony with wrought-iron scroll railing and potted plants (absorbs the former aa_balcony_iron_ground). RETIRED 2026-10-27 (architectural pass): the arched ground-floor window, surround, sill, corbels and balconette are now built into aa_shell_facade (build_shell.py ground_window); the Tripo mesh fused stone, plants and rail into one skewed piece.

Juliet balcony: baroque wrought-iron scroll railing with side returns and three terracotta geranium pots; the top-floor window flower boxes sit inside it. RETIRED 2026-10-27 (architectural pass): top-floor balconies are now built into aa_shell_facade (build_shell.py balcony): stone slab on corbels, drain spout, wrought-iron rail anchored to the wall, two non-identical variants.

Sticker-bombed street cabinet: marquee, CRT screen, control panel, coin door. Screen and marquee driven by emissive + neon mask. Scaled to the reference composition (2.3 m, marquee just under the awning), author note 2026-10-26.
A-frame pavement sign. Board text is texture.
Black cast-iron street post with ball cap. Fills the spec's 'pillars' slot.
Wrought-iron bracket lantern. Warm glow lives in the emissive map only (no neon mask).
Corrugated clear acrylic rain awning on scroll brackets over the street cabinet.
Vertical TOKENS / DRINKS / GAMES / REGRETS sign on bracket, cocktail glass icon lit at night.
Black board right of the door listing the offer, neon cocktail at the base.
Downpipe with brackets, hopper head and shoe.
Purple and green conduit runs drilled across the stone, clips, four junction boxes. Conduit glows at night via the neon mask. The two earcup boxes belong to aa_arch_hero.
Terracotta pot with a leafy shrub (alpha cards).
Enamel '13' plaque.

assets.source: tripo image (recreated from the Mural Board, 4K upscale) + Blender shrinkwrap
assets.contents: Green Fairy mural as a conforming decal: 160x260 grid shrink-wrapped onto the facade walls and mouldings, so the paint runs over the cornice and floor bands. Bottom notch frames the Headphone Gentleman. Token and pixel field glow at night (emissive + neon mask).
Carved limestone acanthus cartouche, first-floor (piano nobile) windows only, seated on the segmental pediments.
Original carved limestone rosette, painted green as part of the Green Fairy mural (reference: 'Painted stone flower detail'). Flanks the Headphone Gentleman inside the pixel mosaic.

Black cat sitting on the OUTSIDE of the open left first-floor window's stone sill, facing the street. Canon by author ruling 2026-10-27 (ambient, not a mascot; see docs/superpowers/NEXT_WORK.md). The window behind it is modeled open (build_shell.py OPEN_WINDOWS).
Terracotta pot with shrub: two on the arched ground-floor window's balconette slab, three on the top-floor balconies (reference crops).
